metadata.name: cometail_vault
metadata.description: COMETAIL vault: custody Meteora fee streams, launch their stream tokens, and turn income into DLMM bids

accounts.name: st_mint
docs: The future stream-token mint. It signs here (still uninitialized) so that only the
holder of the keypair can take this vault address; DBC initializes it at `launch`.

accounts.name: depositor_wsol
docs: The depositor's WSOL ATA: created if missing, pinned as the only payout destination.

accounts.name: income_wsol
docs: Vault-owned WSOL ATA: income.

accounts.name: placeholder_wsol
docs: Vault-owned WSOL account that is not the ATA: the token A destination for claims.

accounts.name: creator_position
docs: Only for a CreatedPool deposit: the creator position already minted, now vault-owned.

accounts.name: stream_index
docs: One per position: a position can only ever be deposited once.

accounts.name: source_position
docs: The depositor's position (source of the slice).

accounts.name: new_nft_mint
docs: Fresh NFT mint for the vault's slice (keypair signs).

accounts.name: admin
docs: The program's upgrade authority. Only it can claim the singleton: the first-caller
takeover between deployment and initialization is closed by binding the admin to the
executable's own ProgramData.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: New treasury: still the admin's WSOL ATA (optional; validated)

accounts.name: stream_index
docs: Index of the primary source (DBC pool or position).

accounts.name: position_index
docs: Index of a registered derived position (DBC rights that migrated), if any.

accounts.name: nft_account
docs: Vault-owned NFT account (if the stream holds a position).

accounts.name: depositor_nft_account
docs: Depositor-owned destination for the NFT.

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: Vault is not in the required status

errors.name: NotDepositor
errors.msg: Only the recorded depositor may do this

errors.name: NotKeeper
errors.msg: Only the keeper may do this

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the admin may do this

errors.name: AccountMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the recorded one

errors.name: ForeignAccount
errors.msg: Account is owned by the wrong program or has the wrong discriminator

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Stream token mint does not match the vault

types.name: PoolFeesStruct
docs: Information regarding fee charges
trading_fee = amount * trade_fee_numerator / denominator
protocol_fee = trading_fee * protocol_fee_percentage / 100
referral_fee = protocol_fee * referral_percentage / 100

fields.name: admin
docs: Protocol owner's wallet. Can set the keeper, treasury, configs and the routing pause.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Hot key that may call `route` and keeper-only `settle`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Protocol owner's WSOL token account: receives the 1/5 share of external stream income.

fields.name: stream_configs
docs: DBC partner configs for stream launches, by preset (25 / 50 / 75).

types.name: RewardInfo
docs: Stores the state relevant for tracking liquidity mining rewards

fields.name: max_spend_per_period
docs: Gross WSOL the keeper may place per period.

fields.name: period_seconds
docs: Period length in seconds; must be positive.

fields.name: max_bins_per_order
docs: 1..=50, DLMM's limit.

fields.name: max_price_q64
docs: Highest price the vault will pay, Q64 lamports per raw stream-token unit, fee-exclusive.

fields.name: is_own
docs: Set only by `launch` and `register_own_position`. Never from client input.

fields.name: pool
docs: DBC rights: the virtual pool and its config; positions: the DAMM v2 pool.

fields.name: derived_damm_pool
docs: DBC rights: the DAMM v2 pool the migration derives to.

fields.name: position
docs: Position (deposited, or the creator position registered after an external migration).

fields.name: one_time_claims
docs: DBC rights only: bit 0 = migration fee already taken upstream, bit 1 = surplus already taken.

types.name: StreamIndex
docs: One per source account (DBC pool, position, NFT mint): nothing is deposited twice.

fields.name: depositor_wsol
docs: Depositor's WSOL ATA, pinned at creation: the only payout destination.

fields.name: st_mint
docs: Stream-token mint, generated client-side and bound at `launch`.

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: The stream token's DBC pool (set at launch) and the DAMM v2 pool it migrates into.

fields.name: st_is_x
docs: true when the stream token is the pair's token X (bids are bid-side below active).

fields.name: bin_bound
docs: Derived from `max_price_q64` at pair registration: an upper bound on bin id when
the stream token is X, a lower bound when it is Y.

fields.name: income_wsol
docs: Vault-owned WSOL ATA: harvested income waiting to become bids.

fields.name: placeholder_wsol
docs: Second vault-owned WSOL account: the token A destination for every claim. Pinned.
